name: KiCad Eagle Exporter
description: Export KiCad 10 boards and single-sheet projects to Eagle XML for Bantam Tools and experimental Fusion import.
description_full: KiCad 10 SWIG action plugin and standalone Python tools. Exports boards or linked board/schematic/library projects. Interface and reports are in Spanish. Windows conversion tested; Linux and macOS need native validation. Fusion editing is experimental.
